parent_objective: preferred-only M224 boundary snippet action anchor

public_gates: M223 snippet corpus coverage against protected key
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repeat or lengthen M229 before the audit
do not loosen the protected-key normal-margin window after seeing M229
do not lower clearance just to satisfy one historical key
hypothesis: M229 proves snippet action anchoring restores replay-surface retention but not the historical protected key. The remaining failure is likely a protected-key coverage/window issue rather than old replay washout.
success_criteria: classify whether M229's protected-key failure is normal-margin-window only or margin-gap collapse
check whether the protected key is represented by the M223 snippet anchor surface
pre-register exactly one next repair path before any more PPO
keep M224 current best unless all protected-key gates pass
failure_criteria: run another PPO seed before the audit
promote M229 because fixed loss and replay gates passed
relax protected-key thresholds after observing M229

commands.name: m230_audit
commands.command: Use M229 artifacts to classify the protected-key failure and pre-register the next repair path.

decision_rule: Only an audit that explains the protected-key failure and pre-registers a bounded repair may unblock further PPO.
next_blocker: Determine whether to add protected-key snippets to the PPO anchor surface, refresh a current-family protected surface, or change the promotion gate hierarchy.
